home.title: Isomaker — Find the best tools for any use case
home.description: One place to find your favourite tools for any use case. Hand-picked design, developer, AI and everyday tools in an isometric world you can explore.
home.h1: One place to find your favourite tools, for any use case
home.intro: Isomaker is a living, isometric world of hand-picked tools. Each district is a use case: design, development, AI, play and everyday life. Every tool is a building you can visit, and every district's landmark holds its weekly top 10. Found a great tool? Submit it, and it could take one of the open spots.

creative.title: Best design & creative tools — Isomaker
creative.description: Hand-picked tools for design, motion, colour, type and illustration. See this week's top 10 in The Canvas, Isomaker's Creative District.
creative.intro: Tools for design, motion, colour, type and illustration that make the internet a little more beautiful. The Canvas is the district's landmark, and its top 10 is below.

story.title: The story behind Isomaker
story.description: Why Isomaker exists: we are a collection of our tools. One place to bring them together, and to make discovering great tools feel like play again.
